# Markdown

> A small, fast Android app (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose) that opens Markdown files from any app and
> renders GitHub-flavoured Markdown in light and dark. No permissions, no network. Apache-2.0,
> made by Babak Bandpey at Cocode.

Application id `dk.cocode.markdown`. `render/` turns Markdown into an HTML page with pure
functions; `ui/` hosts it in a WebView. All tests run on the JVM with Robolectric.

## Docs

- [Website](https://markdown.cocode.dk/): what the app does and the download, in English and [Persian](https://markdown.cocode.dk/fa/)
- [README](https://github.com/cocodedk/markdown/blob/main/README.md): what it is, install, build, test, layout
- [Brief](https://github.com/cocodedk/markdown/blob/main/spec/brief.md): the product brief
- [Specs](https://github.com/cocodedk/markdown/tree/main/specs): one spec per feature
